DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらが御朱印帳です。今お書きした頁には、まだ触れないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is your shrine seal book. Please don't touch the page I've just written on yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。かばんに入れたいのですが、すぐ閉じると墨が隣の頁に付きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帳面をかばんへ入れる前に、閉じると墨が移るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. I'd like to put it in my bag. If I close it now, will the ink transfer to the next page?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether closing the book will transfer ink before putting it in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ乾いていない部分があります。こちらの挟み紙を残したまま、押さえつけずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some parts haven't dried yet. Keep this interleaving paper in place and carry it without pressing it tightly shut.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この薄い紙を入れたままにするのですね。乾いたら取り外してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 挟み紙を残す扱い方を確認し、乾いた後に外してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should leave this thin sheet inside. May I remove it once the ink is dry?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should leave the interleaving paper in place and ask about removing it after drying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、墨が乾いてから、頁に付いていないか確かめて外してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Once the ink has dried, check that the paper isn't stuck to the page before removing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙がくっついていた場合は、強く引っ張らずにこちらへ相談したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 挟み紙が付いた場合に無理に剥がさず受付へ相談するか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the paper is stuck, should I ask you here rather than pull it off hard?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether you should consult the counter without forcibly removing stuck interleaving paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうしてください。無理に剥がすと頁を傷めることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Forcing it off could damage the page.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は雨なので、帳面を袋に入れて持ち帰ります。上から別の荷物を重ねないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 雨を避けて袋に入れ、帳面に荷物を重ねない持ち帰り方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's raining today, so I'll put the book in a bag to take it home. I'll avoid piling other belongings on top of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will protect the book from rain in a bag and avoid placing belongings on top. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 濡れないようにするのはよいですね。帰宅後は袋から出して、頁の状態を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keeping it dry is a good idea. Once home, take it out of the bag and check the pages.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で袋から出し、乾いてから紙を外します。扱い方まで教えていただき、助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰宅後に袋から出し、乾燥を確かめて挟み紙を外すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take it out of the bag at home and remove the paper after it's dry. Your advice on handling it was very helpful.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will unpack it at home, check that it has dried, and remove the interleaving paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 大切にお持ち帰りください。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りくださいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take it home carefully. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この袋は玄米です。精米してお渡しするか、そのままお持ちになるかを伺っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This bag is brown rice. We're asking whether you'd like it polished before collection or would prefer to take it as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもの白いお米と違うのですね。炊飯器に玄米の設定がないので、精米をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 玄米用設定がない炊飯器を使っているため精米を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: So it's different from the white rice I usually have. My rice cooker has no brown-rice setting, so I'd like it polished.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for rice polishing because your rice cooker has no brown-rice setting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承りました。すべて精米する前に、どのくらいの期間で召し上がるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Certainly. Before we polish all of it, please tell me how long you expect to take to eat it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人で週に二度炊くくらいです。袋全部だと、食べ切るまでにかなり時間がかかりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人で炊く頻度を伝え、大袋を食べ切るまで長くかかると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I live alone and cook rice about twice a week. A whole bag would probably take me quite a long time to finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your cooking frequency as someone living alone and explain that a large bag would take a long time to finish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 量を分けて買う方法もあります。少量の袋を選んで、その分だけ精米する形はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also buy a smaller quantity. How about choosing a small bag and having only that amount polished?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず少量の袋にします。精米すると、元の袋の重さより減るのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量の袋を選び、精米後に重さが減るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll start with a small bag. Does polishing reduce the weight from what the original bag weighs?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a small bag and ask whether its weight decreases after polishing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ぬかを取り除くので減ります。精米後の重さと、お渡しする価格を確認してから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It does, because the bran is removed. We'll confirm the weight after polishing and the price before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 重さが変わる理由は分かりました。精米代を含めた金額を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重さが減る理由を理解し、精米代を含む金額を聞いてから決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand why the weight changes. I'd like to decide after hearing the price including the polishing fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show you understand why the weight decreases and say you will decide after hearing the price including polishing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この少量の袋は、精米代を含めて千二百円です。この金額でよければ、精米を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: This small bag costs twelve hundred yen including polishing. If that price is acceptable, we'll go ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その金額ならお願いします。夕方に受け取りに来るので、少量の袋を精米しておいていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提示額に同意し、少量の精米と夕方の受け取りを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: At that price, yes, please. I'll come to collect it this evening, so could you polish the small bag for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to the quoted price and request polishing of the small bag for evening collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 夕方のお受け取りですね、承りました。いったんお帰りになる際も、お気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Evening collection, understood. Please take care on your way home for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 点検中の係員です。こちらの洗濯機で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'm a staff member doing inspections. Are you having trouble with this washing machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 百円玉を一枚入れましたが、金額が表示されません。返却ボタンを押しても戻りませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 百円玉を入れても表示されず返却操作でも戻らなかったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put in one hundred-yen coin, but the amount doesn't appear. I pressed the return button, but the coin didn't come back either.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that a hundred-yen coin was not registered and did not come back when you tried the return button. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 運転はまだ始めていないのですね。機械の番号と、洗濯物を入れたかどうかを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't started the wash yet, correct? Please tell me the machine number and whether you've put laundry inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三番の機械で、衣類は中に入れています。開始ボタンは押していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三番の機械に衣類は入れたが開始操作はしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's machine three, and my clothes are inside. I haven't pressed the start button.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your clothes are in machine three but you have not started it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでは硬貨を追加せず、そのままお待ちください。中の衣類を出せる状態か、私が先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please wait without adding any more coins. I'll first check whether the clothes inside can be taken out.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ百円しか入れていません。別の機械を使う前に、この硬貨の扱いも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加投入前に、戻らない一枚の硬貨の扱いを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've only put in a hundred yen. Before using another machine, I'd like to check what will happen with this coin too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check how the unreturned coin will be handled before adding more money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 投入時の状況を記録し、担当へ確認します。今ここで返金を確約することはできませんが、連絡方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record what happened when you inserted it and check with the person in charge. I can't guarantee a refund here now, but I'll explain how we'll contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その場で返金が決まるわけではないのですね。確認結果は、電話で知らせてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返金がその場で確定しないと理解し、確認結果の電話連絡を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So a refund won't be decided on the spot. Could you let me know the result by phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that a refund is not confirmed immediately and request the result by phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 衣類は出せる状態だと確認できました。電話での連絡をご希望として記録しますので、この受付用紙に番号をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've confirmed that your clothes can be removed. I'll record that you'd like a phone call, so please write your number on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を書きました。衣類を取り出して今日は持ち帰り、硬貨の件は電話を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を書き、衣類を持ち帰って硬貨についての電話を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written my number. I'll take my clothes out and bring them home today, and wait for the call about the coin.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Provide your contact number, take your clothes home, and say you will wait for a call about the coin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録をお預かりしました。衣類を取り出したあと、忘れ物に気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've taken your report. After removing your clothes, please check you haven't left anything behind and take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 柵の向こうを気にしていらっしゃいますが、何か落とされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking beyond the fence. Have you dropped something?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 風で帽子が飛んで、あの柵の奥に落ちました。自分で取りに行こうかと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帽子が柵の奥へ飛んだと伝え、自分で取りに入ろうとしていたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wind blew my hat off and it landed beyond that fence. I was thinking of going in to get it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your hat blew beyond the fence and explain that you were thinking of retrieving it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 柵の先には入らずにお待ちください。帽子の色と、落ちた位置を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait without going beyond the fence. Could you tell me the hat's color and where it fell?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紺色の帽子で、右側の柱の近くです。見える所から指で示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紺色の帽子と柱の近くという位置を、柵の外から係員へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's a navy-blue hat, near the pillar on the right. I'll point it out from where I can see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the navy-blue hat near the pillar to staff from outside the fence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所が分かりました。担当の係員へ伝え、回収できる状況か確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I understand where it is. I'll tell the staff responsible and check whether conditions allow retrieval.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待つ間は建物の中にいてもよいですか。もう一度風で飛ばされそうなので、外では待ちたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再び風にあおられるのを避け、屋内で結果を待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I wait inside the building? It feels as though the wind could knock me about again, so I don't want to wait outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to wait indoors for the result to avoid being buffeted by the wind again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの入口近くでお待ちください。回収できると分かるまで、帽子を追って移動しないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait near this entrance. Don't follow the hat around until we know whether it can be retrieved.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口で待ちます。今日は海には入らず、同行者にもここへ来てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口で待ち、遊泳を見送って同行者を呼ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait at the entrance. I won't go swimming today, and I'll ask my companion to come here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait at the entrance, give up swimming, and call your companion over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から、今日は回収できないと連絡がありました。風で帽子も見えなくなったため、ここでの捜索は終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff have told us it can't be retrieved today. The wind has also carried it out of sight, so we'll end the search here.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残念ですが、今日は諦めます。同行者にも事情を伝えたので、一緒に帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日の回収ができないと聞いて帽子を諦め、同行者と帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's a shame, but I'll give up on it today. I've explained to my companion too, so we'll go home together.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept that retrieval is not possible today, give up the hat, and say you will go home with your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お役に立てず申し訳ありません。お二人とも、風に気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm sorry we couldn't help. Both of you, please be careful of the wind on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込用紙をお預かりする前に、記入した内容をもう一度ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before I take your transfer form, please check what you've entered once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書は三万六千円ですが、用紙には三千六百円と書いてしまいました。まだ手続きは始まっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求額三万六千円を三千六百円と誤記したと伝え、受付前か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The invoice is for thirty-six thousand yen, but I wrote thirty-six hundred yen on the form. Has the procedure started yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote thirty-six hundred instead of thirty-six thousand yen and check that the form has not been accepted yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ受付前です。金額欄を無理に書き足さず、新しい用紙へ書き直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We haven't accepted it yet. Rather than trying to add digits to the amount field, let's fill out a new form.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい用紙を一枚いただけますか。間違えたほうは提出せず、手元で分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新しい振込用紙を求め、誤記した用紙を分けて提出しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Could I have a new transfer form? I'll keep the incorrect one separate and won't submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a new transfer form and say you will separate the incorrect form and not submit it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらをお使いください。請求書の金額を見ながら、桁を一つずつ確かめてお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this one. Look at the invoice amount and check each digit as you write it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三、六、ゼロ、ゼロ、ゼロで、三万六千円ですね。請求書の金額と一致しているか見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三万六千円の桁を読み上げ、請求書との一致を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three, six, zero, zero, zero: thirty-six thousand yen, right? Could you check that it matches the invoice amount?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read out the digits of thirty-six thousand yen and ask them to check against the invoice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その金額で一致しています。振込手数料は別にご案内しますので、請求額と分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That amount matches. We'll explain the transfer fee separately, so please check it apart from the invoice amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 請求額に手数料を書き足さないのですね。支払う総額を聞いてから受付をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手数料を請求額へ書き足さないと確認し、総額の説明後の受付を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I shouldn't add the fee to the invoice amount on the form. Please process it after explaining the total I need to pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should not add the fee to the invoice amount and request processing after the total is explained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この受付方法の手数料は五百円で、請求額と合わせて三万六千五百円です。用紙の振込金額は三万六千円のままで結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: For this method, the fee is five hundred yen, making the total thirty-six thousand five hundred yen. The transfer amount on the form should remain thirty-six thousand yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 総額を確認できました。書き直した用紙だけを提出し、三万六千円の振込をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 総額を確認したうえで訂正した一枚だけを提出し、振込を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed the total. I'll submit only the rewritten form. Please make the transfer for thirty-six thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the total, submit only the corrected form, and request the transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの用紙で承ります。お手続き後は控えをお持ちになり、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-ODA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll use this form. Please take the receipt after the transaction and have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご入浴の準備で、何かお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question while getting ready for your bath?

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 眼鏡がないと足元が見えにくいです。脱衣所で外すか、浴室へ持って行くか迷っています。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 裸眼では足元が見えにくく眼鏡を外す場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Without my glasses, I can't see the ground well. I'm unsure whether to take them off in the changing room or bring them into the bathing area.
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot see your footing well without glasses and ask where to remove them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 眼鏡を置ける場所の案内を確認します。ケースはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the information about where you can leave glasses. Do you have a case?

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ただ、ケースをロッカーに入れると、戻るまで取り出せません。脱衣所で使える置き場所があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケースをロッカーへ入れず脱衣所の置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. But if I put the case in the locker, I can't get it out until I return. I'd like to know whether there's somewhere to leave it in the changing room.
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about a place in the changing room rather than putting the case in your locker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 脱衣所に眼鏡用の置き場があります。ご利用になる前に場所をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a glasses storage area in the changing room. Please look at its location before using it.

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。他の方の眼鏡と似ているので、ケースごと置いて、取り違えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 似た眼鏡との取り違え防止にケースごと置きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. My glasses look like other people's, so I'd like to leave them in their case to avoid a mix-up.
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to leave your glasses in their case to avoid confusing them with similar pairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の物が分かるようにしてください。入浴するかは、移動しやすさも確かめてからお決めください。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please make sure you can identify your belongings. Decide whether to bathe after checking how easily you can move around too.

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。見えにくいまま進まず、脱衣所までの案内を聞いてから考えます。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見えにくいまま進まず移動案内を聞いて判断すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't go ahead while I can't see well. I'll hear the directions to the changing room before deciding.
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not proceed with poor visibility and will decide after hearing guidance on moving around. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、お持ち物の確認はございますか。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else about your belongings you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今はありません。ケースを持って置き場を見ます。難しければ今日は入浴をやめて、友人を待ちます。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 置場を見て難しければ入浴せず友人を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not now. I'll take the case and look at the storage area. If it's difficult, I'll skip the bath today and wait for my friend.
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the storage area and wait for your friend without bathing if it proves difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、置き場までご案内します。どうぞご無理なくお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-SZO-ATAMI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll show you to the storage area. Please do only what you're comfortable with. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お部屋の清掃に伺ってもよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: May we come to clean your room?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し待っていただけますか。机で子どもと工作をしていて、紙と小さい部品を広げています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 室内工作が広がっているため清掃を少し待ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Could you wait a little? My child and I are doing crafts at the desk, with paper and small parts spread out.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a short delay in cleaning because craft materials are spread out in the room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのくらいお時間が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: How much time do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十分ほどです。ごみと作品の材料が似ているので、自分たちで分けてから出かけたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十分で材料とごみを自分たちで分けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: About ten minutes. The rubbish and craft materials look similar, so we'd like to sort them ourselves before going out.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want ten minutes to sort the materials and rubbish yourselves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、片づけが終わりましたらフロントへお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please let the front desk know when you've finished tidying up.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。捨ててよい紙はごみ箱へ、まだ使う紙は袋へ入れます。机の上を判断して片づけてもらうつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 廃紙をごみ箱材料を袋へ分け自分で机を整理すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. We'll put paper that can be thrown away in the bin and paper we'll still use in a bag. We aren't expecting you to decide what to tidy from the desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will sort waste paper into the bin and materials into a bag and tidy the desk yourselves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 床にも、小さい物が残っていないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the floor for any small items left behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ビーズが一個落ちているので拾います。のりはふたを閉めて、道具と一緒にしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 床のビーズ回収とのり閉栓を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: One bead has fallen, so I'll pick it up. I'll close the glue and put it away with the tools.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will retrieve the bead from the floor and close the glue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 清掃の際、お持ち物はそのままにして作業します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When cleaning, we'll leave your belongings as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。片づけられました。これから外へ出るので、フロントで清掃をお願いしたと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片付け後に外出しフロントへ清掃希望を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We've finished tidying. We're going out now, so I'll tell the front desk that we've requested cleaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will go out after tidying and inform the front desk of your cleaning request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご準備ありがとうございます。それでは、よいお出かけになりますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for getting things ready. Have a pleasant outing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お忘れ物がありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。さっき降りた時、折り畳み傘を足元に置いたままにしました。まだここにあるか見てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 降車直後に足元へ忘れた傘を確認したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I got out just now, I left my folding umbrella by my feet. May I check whether it's still here?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check for the umbrella you left by your feet just after getting out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの席にお座りでしたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 後ろの右側です。降りる前に鞄へ入れたつもりでしたが、傘の袋だけが鞄にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後右席と鞄に袋のみある事情を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The rear right seat. I thought I'd put it in my bag before getting out, but only the umbrella sleeve is in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you sat in the rear right seat and only the umbrella sleeve is in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車を止めたまま確認します。こちらで後ろの足元を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check with the vehicle kept stationary. I'll look at the rear footwell.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。青い柄の傘です。座席の上ではなく、足元の横に置きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青柄傘の足元横の位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. It's an umbrella with a blue pattern. I put it beside my feet, not on the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the blue-patterned umbrella and its position beside your feet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに青い柄の折り畳み傘があります。ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's a blue-patterned folding umbrella here. Please check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これです。持ち手に白いひもが付いているので、私の物で間違いありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 白いひもの持手で自分の傘と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's it. There's a white cord on the handle, so it's definitely mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the umbrella is yours by the white cord on its handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかにも、お忘れ物はございませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you left anything else behind?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯と財布は鞄にあります。傘を袋へ戻せました。出発する前に戻れて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯財布所持を点検し傘を袋へ収納したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My phone and wallet are in my bag. I've put the umbrella back in its sleeve. I'm glad I got back before you left.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that you have your phone and wallet and say you have put the umbrella in its sleeve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 間に合ってよかったです。それでは、お忘れ物のないようお気をつけください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you made it in time. Please take care not to leave anything behind. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お決まりになりましたら、ご注文を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your order when you're ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この三つを食べたいです。名前をうまく読めないので、メニューの番号で頼んでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読めない寿司名をメニュー番号で注文したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like these three. I can't read the names well, so may I order using the numbers on the menu?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to order sushi by menu number because you cannot read the names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号でお伝えいただけます。こちらの見本と一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use the numbers. Let's check them against these examples too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四番、七番、九番を一つずつです。見本が二つ並んでいますが、それぞれ一つだけ食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 四七九番を各一つと量を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: One each of numbers four, seven, and nine. The examples show two pieces together, but I only want one of each.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify one each of numbers four, seven, and nine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つずつご注文できます。四番はこちらですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can order one of each. Number four is this one, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。七番と九番も、この写真の物です。四番から順に出していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真を確認し四番から提供してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Seven and nine are the ones in these photos too. Could you serve them in order, starting with number four?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the photos and ask for them to be served starting with number four. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 順番のご希望も承りました。途中で追加される場合は、お声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've noted your preferred order too. If you'd like to add anything as you eat, please let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず三つを食べます。番号を言うと、料理の名前も一緒に教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提供時に料理名も教えてほしいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll eat these three first. When I give you a number, could you also tell me the dish's name?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to be told the dish names when they are served. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お出しする際に名前をお伝えします。覚えたい物は、番号の横へメモできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell you the name when I serve each one. You can note any names you want to remember beside the numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。次は名前で頼めるようにします。今日は四番、七番、九番を一つずつ、この順でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次は名で頼むためメモし今回番号量順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'd like to order by name next time. Today, one each of four, seven, and nine, in that order, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Plan to note the names for next time and confirm today's numbers, quantities, and serving order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。それでは、順にご用意します。どうぞお食事をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll prepare them in that order. Please enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かごの商品を、お会計なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to pay for the items in your basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。急に家族から来てほしいと連絡があったので、今日は買わずに店を出たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 急な家族呼出のため購入せず退店したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sorry, but my family suddenly contacted me to come to them. I'd like to leave without buying anything today.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to leave without purchasing because your family has unexpectedly called you away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品はお戻しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. Will you return the items to their shelves?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ただ、今すぐ戻らないといけません。棚の場所を探す時間がないので、こちらで受け取ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品を棚へ戻す時間がなく職員へ預けたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, but I need to go back right away. I don't have time to find the shelves, so could you take them here?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no time to put the items back and ask staff to take them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりして売り場へ戻します。かごをお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll take them and put them back in the sales area. Please hand over the basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。包装は開けていません。かごには、私が持って来た買物メモもあるので、それだけ取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封を伝え持参買物メモだけ回収したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I haven't opened any packaging. My own shopping list is in the basket too, so I'll just take that out.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the goods are unopened and you would like to retrieve only the shopping list you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身のお持ち物を先にお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check your own belongings first.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メモを取りました。携帯と財布は鞄にあります。お店の商品は全部このかごに残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メモ携帯財布を確認し商品全てかごへ残したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've taken my list. My phone and wallet are in my bag. I've left all the store's items in this basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check your list, phone, and wallet and say all merchandise remains in the basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品の取り置きは、ご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like us to hold the items for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いいえ。いつ戻れるか分からないので、取り置きは頼みません。また来た時に選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻る時刻不明で取置を求めず次回選び直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. I don't know when I can come back, so I won't ask you to hold them. I'll choose again the next time I visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decline a hold because your return time is unknown and say you will choose again next visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、こちらでお戻しします。ご家族の所へお気をつけてお向かいください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll put them back, then. Please take care on your way to your family.
